# `aitbc crosschain status`

Get the real status of a cross-chain swap.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc crosschain status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--swap-id` | text | — | yes | The swap ID (or transfer ID). |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |
| `--wait` | flag | `false` | no | Poll status until a terminal state |
| `--timeout` | integer | `300` | no | Seconds to wait with --wait |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc crosschain status --swap-id <swap_id>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc crosschain status --swap-id <swap_id> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
